propositions: Current import help documentation does not accurately describe the 256-event chunk batching behavior and independent per-pass handling introduced by ADR 0039
Canonical import parser help must be updated to document deferred push, per-event link and status passes, and serial source_id skipping before help artifacts are regenerated
Packaged CLI help and external CLI reference are out of sync with canonical import parser help and must be regenerated via gen_cli_help.py and gen_cli_reference.py
User-facing documentation must explicitly state that imports provide no whole-file atomicity, do not automatically complete partial tickets after crashes, and have concurrent-import race limitations
Help generation and parser test contracts must pass without any changes to importer runtime behavior or modules
